Ithatha njalo i-API yomphakathi ye-Hypixel SkyBlock futhi iqhathanise impendulo ngayinye nesithombe sangaphambilini; izinkambu ezingeziwe / ezisusiwe / ezishintshile zirekhodwa ngesitayela sokubuyekezwa kwekhodi kulogi yezinguquko engenhla. «Inguqulo yamanje» esiqongweni sekhasi ivela enkambini ye-version yemikhakha emibili yemithombo, i-collections ne-skills: njengoba i-Hypixel ibuyekeza ngamaqembu, le mikhakha emibili ayishintshi ngaso sonke isikhathi kanyekanye, ngakho inguqulo entsha iqinisekiswa kuphela lapho zombili izinguqulo zivumelana; uma zingavumelani kugcinwa inguqulo ezinzile edlule futhi kuboniswa «ukuvumelanisa kwenguqulo», ukuze inombolo yenguqulo ingagxumi emuva naphambili. Ukushintsha kwenguqulo kurekhodwa ngokwehlukile kuphaneli «umlando wezinguqulo» futhi akuhlanganiswa nalogi yezinguquko zokuqukethwe kwama-endpoint; naleyo phaneli igcina kuphela izinsuku ezingu-30 ezedlule, imarekhodi angu-20 okungenani. Ukushwibeka kwentengo ku-bazaar kuhlungiwe, kudlandlalelwa kuphela ukwengezwa nokususwa kwesakhiwo sezinto. I-endpoint yamaphakethe emithombo (packs) ithatha njalo inguqulo enenani eliphezulu le-packFormat (lelo nombolo liyashintsha njengoba i-MC ibuyekezwa); lapho i-hash esemthethweni ishintsha, i-zip iyalandwa futhi ikhishwe, futhi ukwengezwa, ukususwa nokushintshwa kwamafayela kuqhathaniswa nge-hash yokuqukethwe; amafayela ombhalo ashintshile akhombisa kuphela izingxenye ezishintshile ngokubomvu nangokuluhlaza, amafayela amasha ngokuluhlaza kuphela. I-endpoint ye-Bingo (bingo) irekhoda isikhathi sokushicilela, sokuqala nesokuphela somjikelezo ngamunye, futhi ibala yonke imisebenzi kugridi engu-5×5 (kusukela kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla, phezulu kuye phansi; chofoza iseli ukuze ubone umbhalo ophelele); ukubala phansi kudlulisela ama-millisecond e-epoch e-start / end kusiphequluli, esibala njalo ngomzuzwana, ngaphandle kokuthikamezeka ukubambezeleka kokuthatha kwe-Actions; amakhodi ombala e-Minecraft (§) emibhalweni yemisebenzi abuyiselwa ngokwephalele esemthethweni; inqubekela phambili yeseva yonke isetshenziselwa kuphela ukubonisa futhi ayihlanganyeli ekuqhathaniseni izinguquko. I-endpoint yokudayiswa kwesikhashana (firesales) ithathwa kabusha njalo lapho isebenza (ngaphambi kokuqala kokudayisa abasemthethweni bangashintsha isikhathi, inani nentengo); ukudayisa ngakunye kuyikhadi elihlukile elibonisa intengo nenani, futhi inkinobho ethi «bonisa idatha eyengeziwe» ivula yonke imijikelezo ne-JSON eluhlaza. Uma ukuthathwa kwanoma iyiphi ingxenye noma iphakethe lomthombo kwehluleka, lokhu kusebenza akushintshi idatha ku-repository.
